example.title: Harbour sailing school building with a barrel roof

brief: A 2000s harbour-front sailing school: a two-storey pale grey metal-clad hall under a low barrel-vaulted standing-seam roof, a porthole window and horizontal sunshade louvres on the gable end, an external steel stair to an upper classroom deck, painted lettering on the side, palms and a flagpole. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
